tldr: Wealthsimple is the most direct competitor mover today, opening a CADD beta with 3.25% promotional rewards and a retail beta for a Canadian-dollar stablecoin. Elsewhere, stablecoins and tokenized deposits, 24/7 trading and AI or voice-led banking are moving from experiments to live products.
themes: Stablecoins and tokenized deposits going mainstream
Voice and AI agents in banking and payments
Fintechs becoming banks / bundling account, card and remittances
Cross-border depositary receipts and market access

highlights.headline: Wealthsimple opens a CADD beta with 3.25% promotional rewards and a retail beta for Tetra's Canadian dollar stablecoin
highlights.why: The most direct competitor in the feed is pairing a promotional rewards rate with a CAD stablecoin, which sets new expectations for CAD digital-dollar products and could pull in rate-sensitive and crypto-curious Canadian customers.

highlights.headline: SoFi's bank-issued stablecoin SoFiUSD is live on Polygon (its third chain) and is described as the first tokenized deposit product at a US bank
highlights.why: A bank-issued, regulated digital dollar offered to 17M members shows incumbent-style banks can ship tokenized money, which is a template Simplii and CIBC could be measured against in CAD.

highlights.headline: CIBC is launching an additional U.S. Canadian Depositary Receipt
highlights.why: CIBC, a direct sibling competitor, is expanding access to US equities for Canadian investors, so Simplii's investing offer should be checked against it.

highlights.headline: NYSE affiliate plans 24/7 tokenized stock trading this month, and Coinbase launched 24/7 USDC-settled equity perpetuals
highlights.why: Round-the-clock equity trading is shifting from crypto venues toward traditional exchanges, which will raise customer expectations for trading hours and settlement speed.
